title: Free literal coordinates lie in the support
statement: Let $T$ be a conjunction of literals on $n$ coordinates and let $\rho$ assign each coordinate a restriction state. If position $j$ in the list of literals of $T$ is free under $\rho$, then the coordinate of the literal at position $j$ belongs to the support of $T$.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a conjunction of literals on $n$ coordinates with distinct coordinates
$\rho$ assigns each coordinate a restriction state
$j$ is a position in the literal list and is free under $\rho$
